title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the role of physical exercise in achieving success at college. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: While many college students bury themselves in books and treat workouts as a waste of time, it is often overlooked that physical exercise plays an indispensable role in achieving success at college. In my view, staying active is not the enemy of study but its solid foundation. First, regular exercise strengthens the body and guarantees the energy that intense coursework demands. A student who jogs every morning is more likely to stay focused through back-to-back lectures than one who never moves. Moreover, working out is a powerful way to relieve stress. When exams and job hunting pile up, a quick run on the track can wash away tension and rebuild mental resilience. In addition, sticking to a fixed exercise routine cultivates self-discipline, and this habit naturally transfers to managing study plans on time. In short, physical exercise is by no means a distraction; rather, it is the cornerstone of college success. Therefore, every student is advised to fit regular workouts into daily life before body and mind break down.
keyPoints: 现象引入加亮立场。本段先用 While many college students bury themselves in books 引 出忽视锻炼的普遍现象，再用 physical exercise plays an indispensable role in achieving success at college 斩钉截铁亮出立场，落实了第一段『亮明立场』的功能，且把题眼 role 直接写进首段。
三角度各带场景。本段用 First / Moreover / In addition 串起身体、心理、自律三个角度， 每个角度都配了校园场景（晨跑保持专注、操场短跑驱散紧张、固定作息培养自律），落实了『主题句加 理由加例子加小结』的论证方法，避免了只喊口号。
否定误解再呼吁。本段用 by no means a distraction; rather, it is the cornerstone 否定误 解、重申立场，再用 every student is advised to fit regular workouts into daily life 发出行动呼吁， 落实了结尾段『重申加呼吁』的功能。
